news_items.headline: Hyatt Investor Day: 11-16% Adjusted EBITDA growth guide through 2028, $1B share repurchase increase
news_items.summary: Hyatt held its 2026 Investor Day on May 28, presenting an illustrative financial outlook of 11-16% Adjusted EBITDA growth and 14-18% Adjusted Free Cash Flow growth annually through 2028. The company also announced a $1 billion increase in its share repurchase authorization.

news_items.headline: Truist raises Hyatt price target to $187 from $181, reiterates Buy
news_items.summary: Truist Financial raised its price target on Hyatt Hotels to $187 from $181 and reiterated a Buy rating, citing continued room to run ahead of Investor Day.

news_items.headline: Bernstein raises Hyatt price target to $202 from $186, maintains Buy
news_items.summary: Sanford C. Bernstein lifted its price target on Hyatt to $202 from $186, maintaining a Buy rating in conjunction with the May 28 Investor Day event.

news_items.headline: Hyatt declares cash dividend of $0.15, ex-date May 29 2026
news_items.summary: Hyatt Hotels announced a cash dividend of $0.15 per share with an ex-dividend date of May 29, 2026.

news_items.headline: Swedbank AB trims holdings in Hyatt Hotels Corporation
news_items.summary: Swedbank AB reduced its stock holdings in Hyatt Hotels Corporation, per a filing reported on May 28, 2026. Magnitude of the trim not specified in the source.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Truist raised PT to $187 from $181 (Buy reiterated, 2026-05-28); Bernstein raised PT to $202 from $186 (Buy, 2026-05-28). Consensus among 15 analysts: ~60% Buy/Strong Buy, ~33% Hold, ~7% Strong Sell.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 (reported 2026-04-30) beat on EPS ($0.63 vs est) and revenue ($1.75B). RevPAR +5.4% YoY, gross fees +8.6%, pipeline +9.4%. Q2 2026 street estimates: EPS ~$0.90, revenue ~$1.84B. Minor headwinds from Middle East conflict and softer Mexico demand noted by management.
